page.notes: The woodcut initial A of "Anticum" is decorative and joined to the word. The running head and page number are printed. "qu'a" at the start is a fragment; the mark over the a is uncertain. In verse 3, "San-fon" (Samson) is printed with a split at the line end and is read with uncertainty. The word before "illum" is unreadable. "sponsam" in the Samson passage is a conjecture: the scan reads "(ponam" and the word is uncertain. The long s is printed as f-like in the psalm and is transcribed as s. The footnote mark "1" is printed at the start of the footnote and is not visible in the psalm body.
